slug: 2026-04-28 State broadband merger limps into a second decade

facts.fact: TechCentral reports that state-owned Broadband Infraco operates a national fibre network (no provinces or km given); article dated 2026-04-28.

TechCentral describes Broadband Infraco as a fibre wholesaler, a 'carrier of carriers' for cheaper long-distance bandwidth, whose biggest public-sector customers were SITA and Eskom (both since lost).

note: Sentech-BBI merger into State Digital Infrastructure Company slipped to 2028/29, a plan, not a fact.
